rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a drug or behavior dependence, and for an unusually strong liking expressed as 有……癮.

example.english: Even after trying to quit smoking for so long, my cigarette addiction still hasn't gone away.
example.traditional: 我戒咗咁耐煙，個煙癮仲未斷。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaai3 zo2 gam3 noi6 jin1 go3 jin1 jan5 zung6 mei6 dyun6
